posts.title: P31 TikTok · tt04-storefront
posts.theme: The virtual storefront and its terms
posts.caption:
Your products deserve a home online, not just a DM thread. 🛍️

A P31 virtual storefront gives you:
• your own storefront link on p31market.com
• up to 10 products or services
• secure checkout through Stripe
• P31 marketing: SEO, Google, Meta and social
• web support for your storefront

There’s no monthly fee for your first 3 months; after that it’s $14.99 a month if you keep your storefront. A 5% fee applies to each sale.

Read the terms and sign up at p31market.com/storefront. Within 7 to 10 days you’ll get a link to set up your shop.

What would you sell first? 👇

#P31Marketplace #VirtualStorefront #WomenOwnedBusiness #ShopSmall

posts.caption:
